title: InsightPilot AI — Confidence & Abstention Contract
description: Schema defining confidence metrics, threshold bands, and abstention rules for prototype decision-intelligence.

score.description: Calculated confidence score on a 0-100 scale

explanation.description: Deterministic rationale for assigned confidence score
explanation.example: High confidence based on direct ERP telemetry logs, high corroborating evidence count (3 systems), and zero conflicting signals.

evidence_count.description: Number of independent validated evidence nodes supporting the finding

high_min.description: Minimum score for HIGH confidence designation

medium_min.description: Minimum score for MEDIUM confidence designation

low_max.description: Scores below this threshold are classified as LOW

abstention_threshold.description: Confidence scores below this value require system abstention

abstention_required.description: Flag indicating whether confidence is below threshold requiring the system to abstain from asserting a primary causal explanation

abstention_reason.description: Explicit reason provided when abstention is triggered
